title: Unit Event — Burn My Soul — Episode2 Strategizing

meta.Event Outline: Vivid BAD SQUAD and Ken burn the candle at both ends figuring out how they'll surpass RAD WEEKEND. Tasked with reigniting fervor in the residents of Vivid Street, Akito tries to burn brighter than ever before, but will it go up in smoke?

rows.Line: Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Akito...!

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line: Hey, isn't that Shinonome from Vivid BAD SQUAD...? I didn't know he was still around.

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line: But why's he all by himself?

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line: Then, the rumors about them breaking up after losing to Taiga were true?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (They're reacting like I expected...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Since that day, everyone around here's lost all confidence in us.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (This just means it'll feel that much better when we get them going.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, here we go.
A few months earlier
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Now, let's start discussing your plans moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: In other words, how you're actually going to surpass RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Kohane, An, Akito & Toya
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Yes!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: So, to get right to it...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: What do you all think you need to achieve in order to be able to say, “We surpassed RAD WEEKEND”?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What do we need to achieve...?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I think we can say that if we figure out a way to achieve a more electric atmosphere.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I still have no idea how we're actually going to pull that off.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Right...
I was under the impression that we'd be able to once we became good enough... But now that we know why RAD WEEKEND happened...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Exactly.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: However, I know of just one way for you to all surpass that event and achieve a more electric atmosphere.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You do...?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Dad, what do you mean...?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Nagi's wishes, the path that we took as RADder, the feelings we created in all the locals...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: You need to overwrite those feelings with something completely new.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Overwrite...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What do you mean when you say that...?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Remember what you said that day when you found out the truth?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: You said you were going to surpass RAD WEEKEND and show us—RADder—what things look like from on top of the world.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: You have to take those feelings and turn them into music—into an event—for everyone to see.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Everyone carries different dreams, different feelings...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Nagi wanted you, the next generation, to go beyond our dream, and I want to be there to see what that looks like.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: All our old friends around town wanted to see her wish fulfilled.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Your audience and the young blood around town have gone cold on you, but I'm certain that on some level, they still want to see someone like you guys surpass that legendary night.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: It may just be their subjective ideas...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
But when that comes true...
When everyone sees that you're going to go further than we could...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: That's when you'll have created the kind of energy that surpasses RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: What do you think...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I mean... I believe that, and I really want it to happen.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, me too...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But the problem is, we don't have what it takes to make that happen right now...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (It's not just skill. We lost our friends, and everyone around here has lost interest in us. And we couldn't have beaten him even if there were a hundred of us.)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: I understand that the road up ahead is going to be rough...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: But I believe in all of you.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: I'll be the first one to tell you all that I want you to go beyond our dream.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
No, the second...
She was the first.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Dad...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Everyone around here wants that to happen. If you can remind them of that hope and give them something to place it in again, then you'll start making inroads.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, okay...
Let's do it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: If we don't do something, nothing's going to change!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Otherwise, we'll never be able to surpass RAD WEEKEND. It's our turn to act.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right...! I promise to do my best!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you very much, Ken.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Now then...
Let's start getting into some of the details.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: From what I understand, your next move involves two things.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
One is simple. Get better.
You'll have no hope of succeeding if you don't.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: The other is to do what I said a second ago. Show everyone around here some new feelings to overwrite the past.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
First, you all need to get better.
And competing against real opponents will force you to do that.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: So, I'll start taking you to some high-level venues where only the best of the best gather. Your job is to battle against them in events.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Where the best of the best gather...?
Places like Crawl Green?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Exactly.
They won't even let you in the door if you're just “good”.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: They even won't let us in...?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: I'll be asking you to do this basically every day while practicing like normal. After school during the week, I'll come pick you up in the car and drive you straight to these live houses.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Drive us...?
Are these places far?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Yes, they are.
You'll find all sorts of unbelievable performers outside of Vivid Street.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Just like RADder, each city has its own homegrown talent that's fought its way to the top.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
You'll be going up against them.
Fortunately, I know someone.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(I see...
We're gonna battle against the best that these places have to offer, teams just like RADder...)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: As for the second thing...
A few weeks later
Kamiyama High School - School Gate

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (It's been a while since then...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (We've each been doing what we need to while Ken's been driving us to live houses...every single day.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (And we've definitely improved after battling against so many tough opponents. Still...)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Even if you do get better, just putting on events like you've been doing until now probably won't get you far.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: It's hard to make a flame burn bright when it's close to going out. You won't get many chances.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Which is why... You're going to split up the work.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: These will be crucial steps towards putting on an event that surpasses RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: First, Akito, you go reignite your audience.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Our audience...?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
I'm sure you already know...
But after your battle against Taiga, people have mostly lost the hope they held for you.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Getting them to feel it again is going to be the furthest thing from easy.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Which is why this is going to be your job.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Even in the most dire of situations, you don't bend or break. You're here right now because you kept fighting and never gave up.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
They were witnesses to that...
They watched you like they were watching RADder.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: If you manage to get back on your feet despite all that's happened... No, not just that, but become unbelievably skilled, then you'll reignite your audience.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hold on. Why just Akito?
Shouldn't we do that together? I mean...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Let me do this alone.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait... Why?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
It's like Ken said.
We aren't gonna get many chances to reestablish ourselves in this town.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, we need to hold off on performing together until we're fully ready. We have to wait for the opportune moment...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Right now, everyone probably thinks that we've all turned tail and ran.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Just becoming a little better isn't going to convince them that we're still serious.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But if I manage to put on an event on my own that's as good as the ones we did together, then they'll consider giving us another chance.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Does that sound about right, Ken...?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Yeah, you got it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: In other words, they'll start thinking, “If Akito alone can do this, what will happen when all four of them get back together?”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Exactly.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Now I get it...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay! Akito, go knock their socks off!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I will.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Akito.
In order to accomplish this, you'll need to become unbelievably good.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yes, I know.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Okay.
Then, I hope you're ready...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: As for you three, I'd like to talk to each of you individually. Starting with...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Right now, I don't have what it takes to reignite their excitement...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (That means I have to get better. A lot better.)
se_event_burn_2023_006

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, you two, the car's here!
This way!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Sorry I'm late.
We got stuck in traffic after I went to pick Kohane up.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
No, that's not a problem.
We actually just got here.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, Ken, where are we going today?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
A place called “Rodin”.
It's somewhere that gave even my team a lot of trouble.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, even you guys?!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Yeah, it's a pretty high-level venue.
Only a few places in Japan can really match it.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: You'll find top-level performers who want to put their skills to the test and even pros signed to major labels there.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: In other words, the audience will have high expectations...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
They will.
You don't stand a chance there yet.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: But what you all need right now are opponents who are ridiculously better than you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Some of the places we've been performing at have been pretty tough. But I guess we're in for something else today.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(But that's what we want...
The bigger the wall, the better we have to get to overcome it.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (We're gonna figure out a way no matter what...!)
